audience: Shopify merchants who run loyalty points, VIP tiers and referrals with Joy

useCases.title: Check a customer's points and tier
useCases.text: Find a loyalty customer by Shopify customer id. Read their points, tier and total points earned.

useCases.title: Review points transactions
useCases.text: List earn, spend and manual adjustment transactions, newest first. Open one transaction for its details.

useCases.title: Review VIP tiers and referral totals
useCases.text: List the VIP tiers with their point targets and member counts. Read the referral totals for the shop.

useCases.title: Award or deduct loyalty points
useCases.text: Add points to a customer's balance, or remove points from it. The change is live and not safe to repeat.

useCases.title: Refund a redeemed reward coupon
useCases.text: Read the reward first. Then refund its redeemed coupon, so the customer gets their points back. The change is live.
